■ Stage Direction
Slightly timidly
Even if it's just a game, I won't lose at kendo!!

Trainer!!
On our next day off, I need you to come with me!

I... want to try talking to those students one more time.
Even if I end up messing up again.
From the heart, huh?

Yes! Do you remember those two students I cracked down on
in front of the arcade at night a while back?

If we investigate the popular ways to "take a breather" these days,
we'll be able to understand how they feel!

Nobody told me there'd be such... indecent scenes!
That's way too stimulating for youth to be watching!!

—And so, the "downtime" investigation with Bamboo Memory began,
however...

Still, hmph... I get what cosmetics and movies are trendy now,
but I still don't understand how those two felt.

Heheh, you never know who'll win till you try!
Let's start with a match on that game over there!
Huh?! Wh-Where are you goiiing?!
Does this mean I haven't reached out enough yet?

Even after trying out popular games, Bamboo Memory didn't seem
able to truly lose herself in the fun. In that case—

Having learned something in her own way,
Bamboo Memory wore a refreshed, radiant smile.

Races and training are important, but maybe taking a breather
and having fun was just as important to them...

This is an investigation, okay? The goal is to learn how people relax,
having fun is strictly secondary!

Trainer, if we get another chance, let's hang out again!
Next time, we'll go... all out!
Alright then, let's check out this trendy lipstick right away—
It's for the investigation! Here, Trainer, drink up!

It felt so refreshing and awesome, and before I knew it,
I got so fired up I completely forgot about the investigation—

Because she was so fixated on conducting an "investigation,"
it felt like she hadn't quite grasped the true essence of relaxing...
Heheh, hearing you say that really boosts my confidence!
Heheh! As the disciplinary committee head, it's only natural!
Mmmgh. Rules... The rules, huh...

Whaaat?! Lipstick this vibrant is totally out of the question!
It's against school regulations!!

Sharing one drink between two people...
Is this really what people do to relax?!

Understood!
Then following those rules, I'm winning next time!

I heard it was a "mature romance movie,"
but what in the world was THAT?!

It feels just like scoring an ippon in a kendo match!
...Maybe I understand how those girls felt just a little bit now.

There's no such thing in kendo!
That's a foul! Foul, I say!!

At the request of a formal Bamboo Memory,
where we headed a few days later was—
...Honestly, that was super fun.

—Now's my chance!!
MEEEEEN!!!!!

All right, all right, all riiiight!!
Did you see my skill execution?!

Up is Men, Left and Right are Dou—I see,
this looks interesting! Let's have a good match!

"Kendo Blade"?
Ooh, a game where you duel with kendo!
A couple-exclusive driiiink?!

Aagh, I lost~?!
What was with that smoke screen?! I couldn't see a single thing!
S-So this is "Memories of the Madonna"...

Ghh... One more time!
Next time, I'll definitely see right through it...!!

Gwah?!
O-One more round! Just one more round, please!

Thanks to you, I was able to realize that today.
I'm seriously grateful!

Running from morning till night, told to train on our days off too!
Is it so wrong to want to catch our breath once in a while?!

I want to put into practice the "compromise"
you talked about back then, Trainer!

It's true, all I was thinking about was cracking down on them.
Just now, and before that too.

The other day, I...
maybe I really did go too far with what I said.

Mm-hmm...
So playing games like this helps you blow off steam?

All right, let's do this!
—We're taking a break like normal students dooo!!!

After that, we visited spots popular with youth
and tried out trendy entertainment, but...

Phew, I'm completely exhausted!
It might be the first time in a while I've played around this much...
